speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that report. Given your fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function, I need to know if you have noticed any changes in your stool color or urine output. Please tell me if your stools have become pale or clay-colored.

REQUEST TEST: Liver function panel (including Bilirubin, Alkaline Phosphatase, ALT, AST, GGT)
REQUEST TEST: Complete blood count (CBC)
REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis B surface antigen and Hepatitis C antibody
DIAGNOSIS READY: Not yet determined
